details: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has reportedly suffered a significant security breach, with estimated losses of $6.3 billion. The hack, which involved an XRP drain and malicious Ethereum code, has contributed to a broad market downturn and altcoin liquidations. Binance has publicly stated its commitment to cover all user losses, raising widespread concerns about the security of crypto exchanges.
title: Binance Suffers $6.3 Billion Hack, Pledges User Coverage

details: The US Federal Reserve has decided to hold interest rates unchanged at 3.75%-4.00% during its latest policy meeting. While the pause in rate hikes might typically offer some market stability, the broader cryptocurrency market has reacted with a "risk-off" sentiment, leading to sell-side pressure on several altcoins, as investors assess the broader economic outlook.
title: Federal Reserve Pauses Rate Hikes, Crypto Market Sees Risk-Off

details: Ripple's stablecoin, RLUSD, has achieved a significant milestone by receiving an investment-grade rating from Moody's. This positive development for Ripple also comes alongside news of a Coinbase deal and a reported $900 million revenue run rate, highlighting growing institutional confidence and adoption for Ripple's ecosystem.
title: Ripple's RLUSD Earns Moody's Investment-Grade Rating

details: Decentralized exchange Uniswap has experienced a substantial increase in its user base, adding 13,137 new addresses. This marks its largest growth spike since 2020, indicating growing adoption and activity on the platform despite broader market volatility and recent security concerns in the centralized exchange space.
title: Uniswap Records Major User Growth, Adding Over 13,000 New Addresses
